verdict.rationale: Stripe Crypto & Stablecoins is a payments and stablecoin infrastructure product, not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. The Stripe MCP server evidence describes the opposite, server-side role: it exposes Stripe tools to external agents. Machine payments let agents pay Stripe merchants, which is also not MCP-client capability, so neither changes the axis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
